visa.kindSub.visa: Citizens of this country need a visitor visa to visit or transit through Canada, however they travel. Most people also give fingerprints and a photo (biometrics).
visa.kindSub.visa-conditional: You may be able to get an eTA instead if you fly and have had a Canadian visa in the last 10 years or now have a valid US non-immigrant visa. Driving, bus, train or boat always needs a visa.
visa.kindSub.visa-conditional-land: Because you’re arriving by land or sea, you need a visitor visa. If you fly instead and have had a Canadian visa in the last 10 years or now have a valid US non-immigrant visa, you may be able to get an eTA.
visa.kindSub.visa-conditional-land-histo: Because you’re arriving by land or sea, you need a visitor visa. If you fly instead, you could get an eTA with your visa history.
visa.kindSub.eta: An eTA is linked to your passport and lets you fly to or through Canada for short stays. Canadian citizens, including dual citizens, and permanent residents don’t use one: they travel with a Canadian passport or PR card.
visa.kindSub.eta-conditional: Because you fly and have had a Canadian visa in the last 10 years or have a valid US non-immigrant visa, you can apply for an eTA instead of a visa for a temporary stay.
visa.kindSub.passport-only: Citizens of eTA countries arriving by car, bus, train or boat don’t need an eTA. You still need a valid passport. Flying later? You’ll need an eTA then.
visa.kindSub.none-us: US citizens and US lawful permanent residents don’t need a visa or an eTA. Bring a valid passport, and green card holders also bring proof of their US status.
visa.kindSub.canadian: Canadian citizens, including dual citizens, need a valid Canadian passport to fly to Canada. They can’t apply for an eTA.
visa.kindSub.unknown: A few questions about your passport and your trip give you IRCC’s own answer in a minute or two.

visa.field.historyHint: If so, you may be able to fly with an eTA instead.

visa.field.greenCardHint: Green card holders don’t need a visa or eTA.
visa.note.israel.title: Which Israeli passport?
visa.note.israel.body: The eTA is for a national Israeli passport. With an Israeli “Travel Document in Lieu of National Passport”, you need a visitor visa.
visa.note.taiwan.title: Which Taiwanese passport?
visa.note.taiwan.body: The eTA is for an ordinary passport issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Taiwan that includes your personal identification number. Other passports need a visitor visa.
visa.note.romania.title: Electronic passports only.
visa.note.romania.body: Romanian citizens with an electronic passport apply for an eTA. With a non-electronic passport, such as a temporary one, you need a visitor visa.
visa.note.hong-kong.title: Hong Kong SAR passport.
visa.note.hong-kong.body: The eTA applies to passports issued by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
visa.note.vatican.title: Vatican-issued documents only.
visa.note.vatican.body: The eTA applies if you have a passport or travel document issued by the Vatican.
visa.note.british-territory.title: British overseas territory citizens.
visa.note.british-territory.body: The eTA applies if you have citizenship through birth, descent, naturalization or registration in this territory.
visa.permitNote: Coming to study or work? A permit isn’t a visa. If you need one, IRCC issues your visa or eTA with the permit.
visa.handoff.checkNote: IRCC’s questions give you a personal answer.
visa.footnote: Based on IRCC’s country lists. Your passport type, travel documents and route can change the answer, so confirm before you book.

permits.steps.title: How it works
permits.step.loa: Get accepted by a designated learning institution
permits.step.loaDetail: Your school gives you a letter of acceptance. It’s always required.
permits.step.pal: Get a provincial or territorial attestation letter
permits.step.palDetail: Needed in most cases, usually after you accept your offer and pay tuition. In Quebec, you need a CAQ instead.

permits.step.fundsDetail: Tuition, living expenses and return travel, without working in Canada.
permits.step.applyDetail: Most people then give their fingerprints and photo (biometrics).

permits.type.open.body: No job offer needed. Only some people are eligible, such as some family members of foreign workers.
